summary: Ansible 15 deprecations: cisco.ucs and dellemc.unity will be removed from Ansible 16, and purestorage.flasharray and purestorage.flashblade were renamed to everpure.flasharray and everpure.flashblade, with the old names kept as deprecated redirects until removal in Ansible 17.
questions: Will cisco.ucs still ship with Ansible 16?
purestorage.flasharray tasks show deprecation warnings, what should I change?
When will purestorage.flashblade be removed from the Ansible package?
How can I keep using dellemc.unity after it leaves Ansible?

answer_card.title: Ansible 15 collection deprecations and renames
answer_card.answer_md:
- **cisco.ucs**: removed from Ansible 16 (development moved to `cisco.intersight`). Install separately: `ansible-galaxy collection install cisco.ucs`.
- **dellemc.unity**: removed from Ansible 16 (no CI for 10 months). Install separately: `ansible-galaxy collection install dellemc.unity`.
- **purestorage.flasharray → everpure.flasharray** and **purestorage.flashblade → everpure.flashblade**: old names are deprecated redirects in 15.0.0 and are removed in Ansible 17. Update FQCNs, e.g. `purestorage.flasharray.purefa_host` → `everpure.flasharray.purefa_host`.
